title: Eager to Hear the Word of God

request.style: English, male solo voice, warm baritone, acoustic guitar, piano, cello, soft drums, reflective and hopeful mood, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
They traveled through the island to Paphos town
Where a magician named Bar-Jesus was found
With the proconsul Sergius Paulus he stayed
An intelligent man in the ancient way
He sent for Barnabas and Saul to come
Eager to hear the word of God in the room

[Chorus]
Eager to hear the word of God
Sergius Paulus sought the living Lord
When the proconsul saw what had been done
He believed in the light that was won

[Verse]
But Elymas the magician stood in the way
Trying to turn the proconsul from the day
He opposed them with his tricks of old
Seeking to stop the story to be told
Then Saul filled with the Spirit looked at him straight
And declared the judgment from God’s own gate

[Chorus]
Eager to hear the word of God
Sergius Paulus sought the living Lord
When the proconsul saw what had been done
He believed in the light that was won

[Bridge]
A mist and darkness came over his eyes
He groped for hands in the surprise
Twisting the straight paths of the Lord he tried
But the hand of the Lord was his guide

[Chorus]
Eager to hear the word of God
Sergius Paulus sought the living Lord
When the proconsul saw what had been done
He believed in the light that was won

[Outro]
Astounded at the teaching of the Lord
He came to faith with a heart transformed
